image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a golden hamster positioned inside a narrow, light-colored enclosure or tunnel. The hamster is facing left, with its head partially obscured by the structure's edge. Its body is stocky and covered in dense, short golden-brown fur, transitioning to pinkish skin on the lower belly and hindquarters. One hind leg and foot are clearly visible, showing small digits. The background consists of beige textured surfaces, likely cardboard or wood.
